products: Lower Freetown, PE Barnyard Organics offers a full range of certified organic grains, legumes, and oilseeds, including wheat, oats, barley, rye, soybeans, and field peas, alongside custom-milled livestock feeds through the East Coast Organic Feed Mill for poultry, turkeys, hogs, goats, and other species. The farm also produces organic chicken and eggs through seasonal CSA-style programs, and provides bulk grain services such as grain cleaning, drying, soybean roasting, and custom feed mixing. Additional offerings include organic seed, soil amendments, Bio-Ag products, and retail grain sales through The Grainery, with farm-gate pickup and regional distribution available. View Profile 902-887-3188 website Bear Cove Resources Storm-Cast
